messages:
incident-bot: [P1] GPU pool 'west-infer-1' exhaustion detected — queue growth > 6k, 5xx rate rising. Autoscaler attempted 3 scale actions, hit pool_max_instances=22. Link: https://metrics.redwood/influx/gpu_pool/west-infer-1

Alice Kim: ack, paging Samir (oncall). suspected autoscale + batching regression.

Samir Patel: I'm on it. Looking at the autoscale logs and the latest deploy. Can someone drop the recent releasenotes/pr that touched batching?

Jules Ortega: root cause signal: prefix_cache_miss_rate for model-family/rw-7b jumped from ~8% -> 87% after 06:22 UTC deploy. Continuous batching latency window also increased in the same deploy (was 40ms -> 260ms). A bigger window + cache misses = longer queues + larger batches that the pool can't drain.

Rae Chen: confirming — PR #4827 changed `continuous_batching.window_ms` and turned off `kv_cache_prefetch` to reduce memory in some smaller instances. That caused cold prefix hits for byte-pair cached prefixes. Misses multiplied per request, causing KV cache thrashing.

Liam Brooks: Customer impact: multiple enterprise customers reported 5xx and high tail latencies. Support ticket: https://support.redwood/t/INC-9879 — 12 affected apps, highest severity. We're seeing increases in error_rate for generation endpoints.

Alice Kim: immediate mitigation plan (short):
1) revert the PR that disabled kv_cache_prefetch (hotfix)
2) temporarily raise pool max_instances to 45 to buy time
3) divert low-priority traffic (non-prod / free tier) to fallback region
4) roll back continuous_batching.window_ms to previous value if revert not fast enough

Samir Patel: executing steps 1 and 2 now. I'll run emergency scale and kick off rollback. Handing to deploy-bot for revert.

deploy-bot: Queued revert: revert-pr/4827 -> staging -> prod (auto-approve off). Estimated time to prod: ~5–8 minutes.

Jules Ortega: running emergency scale:
```
infractl pool update --pool west-infer-1 --max-instances 45 --reason "incident 1773123456"
infractl pool scale --pool west-infer-1 --desired 40
```
Logs: new nodes requested to cloud provider, pending allocation (spot pressure noted).

Rae Chen: while nodes spin up, we should reduce batch size for the model-family to limit per-request resource spike. Command to set policy:
```
redwoodctl model-config set --model rw-7b --max-batch-size 8 --continuous-batching-window-ms 60
```
Applying now.

Alice Kim: I've posted interim customer comms to affected accounts (draft pinned). Marta, can you take external comms?

Marta Lopez: On it. Sending out targeted notes to top 5 affected customers and internal playbook to sales. Will update status page after we confirm queue drain.

Samir Patel: revert PR merged to prod at 06:33 UTC (deploy-bot). Observability shows prefix_cache_miss_rate dropping (87% -> 14%) within 2 minutes. Queue length starting to decline.

incident-bot: autoscale activity: scaled to desired=40 at 06:38 UTC. Instances provisioning healthy; some spot replacements pending.

Jules Ortega: queue reduced from 6.2k -> 450 by 06:45 UTC. Error rate trending down. Confirming no new 5xx spikes for last 5m.

Liam Brooks: support: customer-facing errors resolved for most tenants, hold on follow-ups to confirm for lower-volume customers.

Alice Kim: I'm going to step out for 30m. Samir, you take primary for next 45m?

Samir Patel: taking over. I'll monitor until stabilization and coordinate post-incident follow-up.

Rae Chen: quick root-cause summary for postmortem: PR #4827 disabled `kv_cache_prefetch` and increased batching window for certain model families. The combination caused a surge in prefix cache misses and increased per-request memory/latency, which in turn grew queue depth and caused autoscaler to hit configured maximum.

Marta Lopez: open action items for comms + customers:
- Draft full incident summary by EOD
- Proactive outreach to top 10 affected accounts (assigned)

Samir Patel: infra action items:
- increase autoscale upper limit for west-infer-1 from 22 -> 60 (controlled ramp)
- add alert for prefix_cache_miss_rate > 15% AND queue_growth > 1k in 5m
- add automatic rollback on deploys that change batching or cache flags for production models

Jules Ortega: I've started a quick playbook ticket: INF-2049 (investigation + permanent fix). Also adding a regression test that asserts prefix_cache_miss_rate stays < 10% in canary with realistic prompts.

deploy-bot: revert-pr/4827 verified in prod: all checks green.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Memory pressure normalizing, request latency TTL improved.

Samir Patel: queue fully drained at 07:12 UTC. All error rates returned to baseline. Moving to postmortem and follow-up tasks. If anyone sees a regression re-open thread.

Liam Brooks: closing customer tickets as resolved where applicable; keeping a few open for 24h verification.

Alice Kim: thanks everyone. Postmortem owners: Samir (infra), Rae (ml/regression tests), Jules (observability). ETA for postmortem draft: 48h.

Marta Lopez: I'll coordinate a short blameless incident note to public status and internal comms.

Samir Patel: handoff: Alice cleared, I'm primary until 08:00 UTC. Logging final notes to incident tracker: https://tracker.redwood/incidents/1773123456

Alice Kim: :thumbsup: great work.
